items.headline: Devin Roche, Maurki James help Old Dominion upset Appalachian State 10-3
items.description: — Devin Roche rushed for 101 yards, and Maurki James scored the game’s only touchdown as Old Dominion beat Appalachian State 10-3 on Saturday.

items.headline: Cameran Brown's school-record 6 touchdown passes lead Georgia State to 42-10 rout of Old Dominion
items.description: — Cameran Brown threw a school-record six touchdown passes and Georgia State flew past Old Dominion 42-10 on Saturday.
